biotools.summary: PARATHAA is a tool for taxonomic assignment of 16S rRNA gene sequences that accounts for sequence ambiguity associated with specific primers. It generates primer-trimmed phylogenetic trees and assigns taxonomy to query sequences by aligning them to these trees.
